description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the ProjectAdminAPI within the OrangeHRM Time Plugin. It tests API endpoints related to project administration functionalities, including retrieval of all projects and placeholder tests for create and delete operations.

classes.name: ProjectAdminAPITest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the ProjectAdminAPI endpoints related to project administration in the OrangeHRM Time Plugin.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Initializes test data before any tests are run, truncating specific tables and populating with fixture data.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of all project admin data via the API endpoint, using data provider for multiple test cases.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for the testGetAll method by loading data from a YAML fixture.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the create method of ProjectAdminAPI, expecting a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Tests validation rules for create operation, expecting a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests the delete method of ProjectAdminAPI, expecting a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.description: Tests validation rules for delete operation, expecting a 'not implemented' exception.
